kind: delta addendum recording the L3 operator ruling; the F1 configuration and the A2 addendum are immutable and remain authoritative for everything not defined here

argmax_tie_rule.ruling: Exact argmax ties are resolved using the frozen section-8 class order.
argmax_tie_rule.procedure: the arg-max is the first class in class_order whose probability equals the maximum probability

l3_baseline.ruling: The L3 repeatability baseline is the full 50-state D5 agreement, not the 20-state D6 subset.

l5_halt.condition: L5 halts (INVALID) iff L5 argmax agreement < 41/50, compared as exact fractions
l5_halt.arithmetic: exact rationals: 46/50 - 10/100 = 41/50; never a binary floating-point difference

d6_canaries.status: descriptive only; not the L3 baseline
